title: S1338 (125th General Assembly): Constitutional Carry/Second Amendment Preservation Act Repeal

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2024-05-08; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess125_2023-2024/prever/1338_20240508.htm (LegiScan doc 2994665))
provenance.note: Introduced print dated 2024-05-08; no passage vote. Text never uses a gun word; Act 111 is the S.C. Constitutional Carry/Second Amendment Preservation Act of 2024 (per title).

operative_text:
Section 1: Act 111 of 2024 is repealed.
Section 2: The statutes contained in Act 111 of 2024 revert to the language contained in them prior to March 7, 2024.
